page.overview:
Who is Fuen?

Fuen was the most intellectual member of Furido's team, and displayed a slight superiority complex. She would easily become bored while in battle, which, in nothing but pure arrogance, led her to toy around with her opponents. Fuen usually became amused when her targets would run away from her traps. While fighting Sakura she stated that she despised girls and thought of them to be annoying individuals.

Fuen had long and straight dark brown hair (whose frontal hairline was taped) and wore spherical earrings. Her makeup consisted of red lipstick and an orange-based smokey eye (a makeup technique that gives off the illusion of a colour fade at the creases of the eyes.) She had blue eyes and wore a choker around her neck. Her outfit consisted of a magenta qípáo, the cloth of which being decorated with black and tan stripes. Underneath, she wore light purple stockings.

Fuen has tactical acumen and helps her team by strategizing various obstacles and traps designed to separate and eliminate their opponents. She also showed knowledge in poison, able to use it together with her other techniques for more potent assaults. She is also apparently a skilled artist, able to design maps to act as mediums for her techniques.

Fuen specialised in long-distance combat. She uses an unnamed Earth Release technique to manipulate the surrounding terrain around her through scroll-held topographic pieces. These "maps" linked back to the land around her, which allowed her to toy around with her opponents and strategise with all her newly bought time. Additionally, if she had placed a tracker on a target before hand, she was able to monitor their exact location and strike accordingly. She could use Earth Release to travel through rock and even launch several spears of stone at her opponents by focusing chakra into the ground beneath her. As a testament of her skill with barrier ninjutsu, she was able to enclose an entire village within the confines of her Barrier Gate Five Seals Technique: Castle Closing Eight Gates.
